purpose: Bury one or two stated facts in a long document and ask a single short question about them, so accuracy can be read against context length, needle position and distractor volume by exact match.
system: Answer using only the document you are given. Reply with the answer alone: no explanation, no restatement of the question, no quotation.

context.description: The assembled document: filler sentences with the needle placed at the configured depth, plus any distractors.

question.description: The single short question whose answer is the buried fact.

expectations: The answer alone, with no surrounding prose.

metadata.author: suite
metadata.change_reason: First version: native.long_context needs a prompt whose only variable across the depth, position and distractor sweeps is the document, so a change in accuracy is attributable to the context rather than to the instruction.
